format.note: Fields are meaningful, examples are concrete, and given/when align with the operation and change facts. Semantic detection limitations are explicitly labeled.

generality.note: The rule and examples apply across asynchronous balance, inventory, and quota stores without application-specific recipes.

decisionUseful.note: Coder-facing fields specify atomicity options, precondition placement, failure compensation, persistence ordering, and prohibited locking patterns.

extraObligations: verifier_detail says to flag a constant/global lock whenever an owner id is available in scope. The specification prohibits a global lock only when a per-owner lock suffices; availability of an owner id alone does not establish that condition.

requiredFixes: Qualify the global-lock verifier to flag locks across unrelated owners only when per-owner serialization suffices, matching the specification and the existing avoid entry.
summary: The convention carries all specified knowledge and has concrete, domain-neutral implementation guidance with no prohibited leakage. One verifier broadens the global-lock prohibition beyond the specification and should retain its per-owner-sufficiency condition.
